# ---- Plan settings (country scope; town_plans.py PAYBACK_STEPS, the settings tab reads them) ----
# The payback limit in years, 0 = any payback: every plan's (pp_tplan_pb_all, a step of PAYBACK_STEPS), and each
# plan's own (pp_tplan_pb_<plan>: a step, 13 = any payback; unset = the all-plans value).
pp_tplan_pb_years_all = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_pb_all }
		if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 1.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 2.5 } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 3.5 } value = 3 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 4.5 } value = 4 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 5.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 6.5 } value = 7 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 7.5 } value = 10 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 8.5 } value = 15 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 9.5 } value = 20 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 10.5 } value = 30 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 11.5 } value = 40 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_all < 12.5 } value = 50 }
	}
}
pp_tplan_pb_years_camels = {
	value = pp_tplan_pb_years_all
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_pb_camels }
		value = 0
		if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_camels < 1.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_camels < 2.5 } value = 2 }

		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_tplan_pb_saltpeter < 12.5 } value = 50 }
	}
}

# The switches, 1 = the default: never at a loss, wait for free workers, take turns; and the game's own
# automation that closes buildings, 1 = on.
pp_tplan_loss_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_loss_ok }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_staff_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_staff_off }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_order_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_order_best }
		value = 0
	}
}
pp_tplan_close_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { is_system_automated = closebuildings }
		value = 1
	}
}

# One payback step from scope:pp_tplan_cur (the index it starts from, any = the last step + 1): longer (past the
# last step: any payback) and shorter (from any: the last step; never below the first).
pp_tplan_pb_next_up = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	add = 1
	max = 13
}
pp_tplan_pb_next_down = {
	value = scope:pp_tplan_cur
	subtract = 1
	min = 1
}
